next_pdcp_phase: family-by-family reduction receipts and OPS3-safe roadmap reconciliation after complete family design-closure review
notes: PCA-12 owns the reusable analysis workbench and replaceable engine adapters; canonical domain owners retain model meaning and pass/fail interpretation.
Formal proof claims are always scoped to the declared model, version, assumptions and bounds.
Monte Carlo and agent-based outputs are statistical or scenario evidence and cannot substitute for deterministic golden proof.
Solver UNKNOWN, timeout, unsupported theory and exhausted bounds are inconclusive rather than coerced into pass/fail.
Optimization may not invent objectives, priorities, weights, tie-breakers or soft constraints.
Permission filtering occurs before model/graph/constraint construction, not merely at final display.
Analysis findings can create proposals but cannot directly mutate canonical owner state.
No new family or standalone tranche is required; residual implementation fits existing PCA/MRCS/GPR/MERA/MBES/MSLR/MSWI work.
